subject: Post-demo: Security discovery, IR notification playbook & vendor questionnaire
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@starlifthealth.com>, ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: Security discovery, IR notification playbook & vendor questionnaire

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and follow-ups on the security/compliance items we promised to surface after the call: 

Summary from our side
- Redwood is SOC 2 Type II in progress; we have a bridge report and a summary of scope and control owners (see request below).
- We support encrypted-at-rest with customer-managed KMS for Private deployments, and full TLS in transit for hosted API.
- Incident response (IR) notification windows: our standard is 72 hours for confirmed data-exfiltration affecting customer data; we can discuss SLA exceptions for enterprise contracts.

Immediate asks from Starlift (as discussed)
1) Please confirm SOC 2 status and provide any summary artifacts you can share (cert or bridge).
2) Share the incident response playbook relevant to breach notification timelines (high-level is fine).
3) We will send a short vendor security questionnaire — please have your security contact complete within 7 business days.

Next steps
- I’ll attach the questionnaire and an IR checklist template for your security team to fill.
- Ben will follow up on procurement/timing for Dedicated capacity if you decide to proceed.
- Neha (cc) is our lead on SOC2/IR coordination and will be the primary point for evidence collection.

Target dates
- Questionnaire sent today (attached) — requested return by 2026-02-27.
- IR artifacts or SOC2 summary requested by 2026-03-03.

If any of those timelines are tight for you, let us know and we can prioritize particular artifacts.

Thanks,

Priya Natarajan
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachment: vendor_questionnaire_starlift.xlsx (xlsx, 45KB)
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@starlifthealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@starlifthealth.com
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Security discovery, IR notification playbook & vendor questionnaire

Hi Priya —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few quick notes from our side: 
- We are LD’ing procurement timeline to late March; 7 business days for the questionnaire should be OK but I’ll flag the items our security team typically pushes back on (notifications + retention).
- Our security lead (security@starlifthealth.com) will take the questionnaire. Can you include any example timelines you referred to (72 hours) directly in the questionnaire or as a short appendix?

Also: to be transparent, we require a formal IR notification SLA in our contracts for customer data exposures; can Redwood provide a short, contract-ready clause or example wording?

Liam
Liam O'Neill
Head of Product, Starlift Health
liam.oneill@starlifthealth.com

Priya / Neha —

Thanks for the materials. Quick status update from Starlift security: 
- We are SOC 2 Type II in process; the most recent bridge summary is attached (SOC2_certificate_summary.pdf). We cannot share the full report externally until our legal signs an NDA, but the summary contains scope and last audit date.
- We’ve filled the vendor_questionnaire with high-level answers where available; see inline comments in the returned sheet.
- Our IR timeline: for confirmed customer data exposure we adhere to a 48-hour initial notification (internal) and a 72-hour customer notification window; we understand Redwood’s 72-hour baseline and would like contract language that supports a 48-hour enterprise option.

We are attaching a high-level BCP/DR matrix with our primary contacts and expected RTOs (BCP_DR_matrix.xlsx). For any sensitive artifacts we’ll request the NDA referenced above.

Attach: SOC2_certificate_summary.pdf (pdf, 85KB), BCP_DR_matrix.xlsx (xlsx, 60KB)

—Starlift Security Team

  3) Send secure transfer link and NDA template to Starlift for full SOC2 report exchange if they sign (Owner: Priya) — action today.
